June 2025 Public Appointments – The Elliott Community Board of Trustees
Closed Meeting Summary
notes:
Mayor Guthrie called the meeting to order (7:27 p.m.) and spoke regarding the matters discussed in closed session, noting the following:

June 2025 Public Appointments – The Elliott Community Board of Trustees

motions.text: That the minutes of the open Council Meetings held May 13, 14, 15 and 27, 2025, and the open Committee of the Whole minutes held May 6, 2025 be confirmed as recorded and without being read.
motions.text_html: 1. That the minutes of the open Council Meetings held May 13, 14, 15 and 27, 2025, and the open Committee of the Whole minutes held May 6, 2025 be confirmed as recorded and without being read.

motions.item_title: Committee of the Whole Consent Report
motions.text: That the June 24, 2025 Committee of the Whole Consent Agenda identified below be adopted.
motions.text_html: 1. That the June 24, 2025 Committee of the Whole Consent Agenda identified below be adopted.

motions.text: That recommendations outlined in the Community Benefit Agreement Program Review – 2025-220 staff report dated June 3, 2025 be approved.
motions.text_html: 1. That recommendations outlined in the Community Benefit Agreement Program Review – 2025-220 staff report dated June 3, 2025 be approved.

motions.item_title: 2025 Corporate Asset Management Plan and Levels of Service - 2025-45
motions.text: That Council approve the 2025 Corporate Asset Management Plan, including the targeted asset levels of service, for submission to the Ministry of Infrastructure on or before July 1, 2025.
motions.text_html: 1. That Council approve the 2025 Corporate Asset Management Plan, including the targeted asset levels of service, for submission to the Ministry of Infrastructure on or before July 1, 2025.

motions.item_title: Ontario Health – Multi-Sector Service Accountability Agreement, Declaration of Compliance - 2025-273
motions.text: That the Mayor be authorized to sign the Declaration of Compliance for the Ontario Health Multi-Sector Service Accountability Agreement for the period of April 1, 2024 to March 31, 2025.
motions.text_html: 1. That the Mayor be authorized to sign the Declaration of Compliance for the Ontario Health Multi-Sector Service Accountability Agreement for the period of April 1, 2024 to March 31, 2025.

motions.text: That the City of Guelph 2024 Consolidated Financial Statements and External Audit Findings Report, dated June 24, 2025, be approved.
motions.text_html: 1. That the City of Guelph 2024 Consolidated Financial Statements and External Audit Findings Report, dated June 24, 2025, be approved.

motions.item_title: Committee and Board Vacancies due to Ward 6 Vacancy - 2025-315
motions.name: First Motion
motions.text: That Councillor Klassen be appointed as the Committee of the Whole Infrastructure, Development and Environment Services chair for a term ending November 15, 2026.
motions.text_html: 1. That Councillor Klassen be appointed as the Committee of the Whole Infrastructure, Development and Environment Services chair for a term ending November 15, 2026.

motions.item_title: Committee and Board Vacancies due to Ward 6 Vacancy - 2025-315
motions.name: Second Motion
motions.text: That Councillor Chew be appointed as the Committee of the Whole Infrastructure, Development and Environment Services vice-chair for a term ending November 15, 2026.
motions.text_html: 1. That Councillor Chew be appointed as the Committee of the Whole Infrastructure, Development and Environment Services vice-chair for a term ending November 15, 2026.

motions.item_title: Committee and Board Vacancies due to Ward 6 Vacancy - 2025-315
motions.name: Third Motion
motions.text: That a decision on the Committee and Board vacancies, as a result of the vacant Ward 6 Councillor seat, for the Board of Trustees of The Elliott, and the Well Interference Committee, be deferred to the September Council meeting cycle to allow the July 23, 2025 appointment of an individual to the vacant Ward 6 seat to occur.
motions.text_html: 1. That a decision on the Committee and Board vacancies, as a result of the vacant Ward 6 Councillor seat, for the Board of Trustees of The Elliott, and the Well Interference Committee, be deferred to the September Council meeting cycle to allow the July 23, 2025 appointment of an individual to the vacant Ward 6 seat to occur.

motions.item_title: Authority to move into closed meeting
motions.text: That the Council of the City of Guelph now hold a meeting that is closed to the public, pursuant to Section 239(2)(b) of the Municipal Act, regarding personal matters about an identifiable individual, including municipal or local board employees.
motions.text_html: 1. That the Council of the City of Guelph now hold a meeting that is closed to the public, pursuant to Section 239(2)(b) of the Municipal Act, regarding personal matters about an identifiable individual, including municipal or local board employees.

motions.text: 1.That Ted Sehl and Kathy Wilkie be appointed to The Elliott Community Board of Trustees for a 3-year term ending June 2028, or until such time as a successor is appointed. 2.That David Kennedy be re-appointed to The Elliott Community Board of Trustees for a 1-year term ending June 2026, or until such time as a successor is appointed.
motions.text_html:
1. 1.That Ted Sehl and Kathy Wilkie be appointed to The Elliott Community Board of Trustees for a 3-year term ending June 2028, or until such time as a successor is appointed.
  2. 2.That David Kennedy be  re-appointed to The Elliott Community Board of Trustees for a 1-year term ending June 2026, or until such time as a successor is appointed.

motions.text: That by-laws (2025) - 21100, (2025) - 21102, (2025) - 21104 and (2025) - 21110 be approved subject to Section 284.11 (4) of the Municipal Act.
motions.text_html: 1. That by-laws (2025) - 21100, (2025) - 21102, (2025) - 21104 and (2025) - 21110 be approved subject to Section 284.11 (4) of the Municipal Act.
